thread:
Ava (Content): Quick kickoff — we're shipping the "Edge Starter" OSS kit. Goals: short launch post, a compact benchmark blurb, 45m webinar + 30m lab. Keep tone dev-first. :rocket:
Priya (DevRel): Agreed. Lab needs to be 20-25m runnable. Repo should have /quickstart, /bench, /lab-checklist. Make every command copy-paste.
Liam (PM): Benchmark angle: small-batch edge cost + p90 latency at 512 tokens. We should show a single reproducible matrix and link CSV. No hype.
Noah (SRE): I'll run bench on a small GPU node and a CPU edge sim, drop CSV and simple chart. Minimal run command:
```
./bench/edge-bench --model rwd-mini --seq 512 --concurrency 2
```
Evelyn (Growth): Landing page: utm=oss_edge_starter -> HubSpot list. Promo cadence: announce, 2 reminders, day-of paid. Need 3 tweets and a short workshop CTA.
Ava (Content): Draft headline idea: "Edge Starter: quickstart for private LLM inference." Will draft blog + tweet thread by Wednesday.
Priya (DevRel): Speakers: Priya (devrel) + Liam (pm) + Noah (ops). Agenda: 20m demo, 15m bench walkthrough, 10m Q&A, 30m lab. Record and post.
launch-bot: Reminder: use template "webinar-standard" and schedule >=3 weeks out.
Noah (SRE): Action items: bench CSV, docker image (tiny), single-file k8s manifest for the lab. I'll upload artifacts to /bench tomorrow AM.
Evelyn (Growth): HubSpot workflow: registrants -> "OSS Edge Starter" list; attended -> tag oss_edge:attended; >2 opens -> mark warm & notify AE channel.
Ava (Content): Tiny demo snippet for the blog:
```
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 redwood/edge-starter:latest
curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"Summarize this repo"}'
```
Priya (DevRel): Also add a troubleshooting section: common docker errors, CPU fallbacks, and quick quantization notes.
Liam (PM): I'll write the bench narrative and speaker notes. Dry-run one week before.
Ava (Content): Owners recap: Ava=blog+tweets, Priya=repo+lab, Noah=bench+artifacts, Liam=speaker notes, Evelyn=landing+HubSpot. I'll collate into checklist once drafts land.
Priya (DevRel): Starting repo skeleton now.
Noah (SRE): Bench run scheduled tomorrow morning — will post CSV here.
Ava (Content): Awesome — keeping this thread as single source of truth. Any blockers?
Priya (DevRel): None. Off to scaffold. :+1:
